title: Think-on-Graph 3.0: Efficient and Adaptive LLM Reasoning on Heterogeneous Graphs via Multi-Agent Dual-Evolving Context Retrieval
reasoning: The paper's focus is on technical performance enhancement for question-answering systems using graph-based retrieval. It does not include any components for evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning. The 'Ethical Considerations' section is a standard, brief disclaimer and not a core part of the research contribution.
